Searched the catalog · GekkoScience KBOX 22 TH/s

Right — the KBOX listing isn't on the store anymore, so there's nothing to order there.

Closest thing you can buy today is the Harlo B30 you were looking at: $899, 30 TH/s, 485 W at the wall in Turbo (about $35 a month at 10¢/kWh), and quiet enough for a home office at ~50 dB.

What do you pay for power?

Honestly, I don't have the reason — the listing just isn't live on our store anymore. I've passed it to Georges so you get a straight answer by email, usually within a business day; he can also jump into this chat.

If you want a similar compact unit now, the B30 is where I'd point you.
Handed to the team · No reason available for why the GekkoScience KBOX listing is gone; shopper asked

The team has it and will pick it up right here — stay in the chat and you'll get the answer, or by email if you step away.
